messages.text: How do changes in Wi-Fi 7/8 technology affect the measurement capability required from Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer?

### Short answer
Wi‑Fi 7/8 increases the required Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer capability mainly in bandwidth, modulation quality/EVM, multi‑RF‑chain/MIMO/MLO handling, Wi‑Fi 8 feature analysis, and—in Wi‑Fi over mmWave cases—mmWave frequency and OTA/spurious coverage.[11][12][55][58][14]
### Measurement capability impact
| Technology change | Effect on SG / SA measurement capability |
|---|---|
| Wi‑Fi 7 uses 320 MHz channel bandwidth, 4096 QAM, up to 16 spatial streams, and MLO.[11] | The test setup must support wide WLAN bandwidth, high‑order modulation/EVM verification, and multi‑antenna / multi‑RF‑chain operation rather than only single‑link RF checks.[11][12] |
| Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing needs RF TX/RX measurements in signaling mode under real‑world conditions, and MLO makes multiple RF chains important.[12] | Measurement capability must include signaling‑mode TX/RX analysis and a test environment with multiple RF chains for MLO behavior.[12] |
| Wi‑Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing measures antenna, RF transmitter/receiver, and multi‑antenna performance under realistic multipath RF conditions.[3] | Analyzer/generator capability may need to operate inside OTA chamber workflows, not only conducted RF setups.[3][52] |
| Wi‑Fi 8 retains Wi‑Fi 7 core PHY parameters: frequencies up to 7.125 GHz, channel bandwidth up to 320 MHz, 4096QAM, and MLO.[55] | Native Wi‑Fi 8 SG/SA coverage still needs sub‑7.125 GHz WLAN frequency coverage, 320 MHz bandwidth, 4096QAM quality, and MLO-related measurement capability.[55] |
| Wi‑Fi 8 shifts emphasis toward ultra‑high reliability and adds dRU and UEQM test focus.[56][58] | Analyzer capability must support dRU measurements for uplink transmit power boost / reliability checks and UEQM analysis for per‑MIMO‑link modulation adaptation against specified MCS combinations.[58][60] |
| A 480 MHz WLAN waveform was demonstrated only as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn candidate, while CMP180 supports bandwidths up to 500 MHz.[54] | 480 MHz should be treated as an R&D / candidate waveform bandwidth requirement, not as a formal Wi‑Fi 8 standard requirement.[54][5] |
### Instrument capability references from the passages
| Instrument / role | Confirmed capability relevant to the requirement |
|---|---|
| R&S SMM100A Vector Signal Generator | Frequency range is 100 kHz to 44 GHz, internal RF modulation bandwidth is up to 2 GHz, and the source states RF frequency and modulation bandwidth are used for future WLAN requirements.[16][17] |
| R&S SMM100A Vector Signal Generator | The SMM100A specifications include IEEE 802.11be EVM signal performance examples.[40] |
| R&S FSW67 Signal and Spectrum Analyzer | R&S FSW67 is a 2 Hz to 67 GHz signal and spectrum analyzer.[19][76] |
| R&S FSW67 Signal and Spectrum Analyzer | Available analysis bandwidth options include 320 MHz, 512 MHz, 1.2 GHz, 2 GHz, 4.4 GHz, 6.4 GHz, and 8.312 GHz under the stated option conditions.[74][75] |
| R&S FSW67 in WoMT RD setup | The WoMT RD site setup lists R&S FSW67 as signal analyzer and R&S SMM100A as signal generator for Tx/Rx measurement.[90] |
### Limits
The passages do not support treating 480 MHz as an official Wi‑Fi 8 channel bandwidth; they only state it was a potential waveform candidate for a yet‑to‑be‑defined IEEE 802.11bn standard.[54][5]  
The passages do not support deriving CMX500 Wi‑Fi 8 option codes, RF chain count, test case list, or measurement uncertainty from the Wi‑Fi 8 PR material.[9]  
The passages state a conflict around SMM100A frequency range in WoMT project material, so the official SMM100A maximum should be kept as 44 GHz rather than using the project deck’s 67 GHz claim.[17][71]

| R&S FSW67 Signal and Spectrum Analyzer | R&S FSW67 is a 2 Hz to 67 GHz signal and spectrum analyzer.[19][76] |
| R&S FSW67 Signal and Spectrum Analyzer | Available analysis bandwidth options include 320 MHz, 512 MHz, 1.2 GHz, 2 GHz, 4.4 GHz, 6.4 GHz, and 8.312 GHz under the stated option conditions.[74][75] |
| R&S FSW67 in WoMT RD setup | The WoMT RD site setup lists R&S FSW67 as signal analyzer and R&S SMM100A as signal generator for Tx/Rx measurement.[90] |
### Limits
The passages do not support treating 480 MHz as an official Wi‑Fi 8 channel bandwidth; they only state it was a potential waveform candidate for a yet‑to‑be‑defined IEEE 802.11bn standard.[54][5]  
The passages do not support deriving CMX500 Wi‑Fi 8 option codes, RF chain count, test case list, or measurement uncertainty from the Wi‑Fi 8 PR material.[9]  
The passages state a conflict around SMM100A frequency range in WoMT project material, so the official SMM100A maximum should be kept as 44 GHz rather than using the project deck’s 67 GHz claim.[17][71]

answer.question: How do changes in Wi-Fi 7/8 technology affect the measurement capability required from Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer?

passages.text:
Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術背景
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 列出的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] throughput-related components 包含：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| 320 MHz channel bandwidth | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| up to 16 spatial streams | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| 4096 QAM modulation | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| [[MLO]] | key component；also key feature making multiple RF chains important |

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 提供 solution-level update：[[Bluetest]] earlier integrated WLAN testing capabilities 現在支援 [[Wi-Fi 7]] bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 則以背景段落描述 [[IEEE 802.11be]] / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 是 next generation Wi-Fi technology，面向 extremely high data throughput、tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。

以上皆為來源對 Wi-Fi 7 與整合測試能力的敘述，不等同於 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]]、[[Bluetest]] RTS 或 [[EMITE]] chambers 對所有 feature combination 的完整規格保證。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 為什麼需要 OTA 與 multiple RF chains
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 指出，在 WLAN devices development 期間，需要在 real-world conditions in signaling mode 下量測 antennas 以及 RF transmitter / receiver characteristics。由於 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很關鍵。

同一來源同時將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester；其 flexibility、support for multiple radio technologies 與 embedded IP test capabilities 使其可用於 broad range of Wi-Fi 7-specific tests。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 進一步把 Wi-Fi 7 OTA 測試放入更廣的 [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 情境：同一 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] / [[Bluetest]] RTS workflow 同時涵蓋 WiFi、[[LTE]]、5G SA / NSA 的 radio and antenna performance validation。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 沒有使用 MIMO stress testing 一詞，也沒有提供 RF chains、spatial streams 或 chamber reflection model；它的貢獻是確認另一個 OTA chamber vendor [[EMITE]] 也將 [[R&S CMX500]] 整合到 [[Wi-Fi 7]] OTA measurement solution 中。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 是在 over-the-air、signaling mode 與 realistic multipath RF conditions 下，對 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points 的 antenna、RF transmitter / receiver 與 multi-antenna performance 進行壓力測試的測試情境。新匯入的 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 補充另一個 partner integration 視角：[[EMITE]] OTA chambers 可整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 最新測試能力，用於 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] device performance assessment。

Wi-Fi 8 › CES 2026 外部待讀連結
[[WiFi8]]（raw converted 2026-09-17）是 OneNote link hub，列出與 [[CES 2026]]、[[Broadcom]]、[[ASUS]]、[[MediaTek]]、[[Filogic 8000]] 與 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 相關的外部文章連結。該來源只提供連結標題與 URL，未擷取正文，因此目前只能支撐 [[Wi-Fi 8 外部資料清單]]，不能作為標準內容、晶片規格、路由器展示或量產時程的證據。

可追溯的連結線索包括：

- Tom's Hardware 標題提到 [[Broadcom]] two dual-band [[Wi-Fi 8]] chips。
- TechNews / The Verge 標題提到 [[Wi-Fi 8]] router / CES before most users have switched to [[Wi-Fi 7]]。
- RCR Wireless 標題提到 [[MediaTek]] previews [[Filogic 8000]] at [[CES 2026]]。
- EDN 標題提到 [[Wi-Fi 8]] silicon 與 AI touch。
- Network World 標題提到 [[Wi-Fi 8]] prioritizes reliability over speed gains。

以上均為待讀線索，不新增本頁的技術規格主張。

Wi-Fi 8 › 使用限制
- 本頁目前由 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]、[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 與 [[WiFi8]] 支撐。
- [[WiFi8]] 是 OneNote link hub，不是文章正文、datasheet、configuration guide、IEEE standard text 或 certification document。
- PR / demonstration statement 不等同於 IEEE standard text、datasheet、configuration guide 或 certification document。
- 來源未標示 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] draft version、standard version、final ratification date 或 IEEE document number。
- 來源未列出完整 [[Wi-Fi 8]] PHY / MAC feature set、band plan、regulatory conditions、test requirements 或 interoperability criteria。
- 480 MHz waveform 僅能記為 MWC 2024 PR 中的 potential candidate，不可寫成 Wi-Fi 8 正式規格。
- 320 MHz channel bandwidth 僅能記為較晚 R&S / Broadcom PR 對 retained core PHY parameter 的說法，不可替代 IEEE 802.11bn 正式文件。
- 不可從 [[WiFi8]] 的連結標題推論 [[Broadcom]]、[[MediaTek]]、[[ASUS]] 或 [[Filogic 8000]] 的產品規格、上市時間、供應關係或認證狀態。

Wi-Fi 8 › 來源中的技術定位
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]：

- [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment introduces advancements focused on consistent, high-quality connectivity across dense environments。
- 目標應用包含 growing number of connected devices、VR/AR、8K streaming、industrial IoT。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] builds upon [[Wi-Fi 7]] foundation。
- 來源明示 final IEEE standard ratification 尚未完成；[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的測試是在 ratification 前展示。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 在 MWC 2024 語境下仍是 yet-to-be-defined standard。
- 來源稱 even wider channel bandwidths are in discussion。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform loopback mode verification，並稱該 waveform 是 [[Wi-Fi 8]] potential waveform candidate。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests
[[Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 中描述的 [[R&S CMX500]] signaling mode 測試能力，用於驗證 prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] WLAN device 的 physical layer features。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests › 與 Wi-Fi 7 OTA 測試的區分
本頁不同於 [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]]：

- [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 目前由 Bluetest / EMITE OTA chamber PR 支撐，聚焦 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] over-the-air chamber workflow。
- [[Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests]] 目前由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] / [[Broadcom]] PR 支撐，聚焦 [[R&S CMX500]] signaling mode、[[Wi-Fi 8]] PHY features 與 prototype Broadcom WLAN device。
- 本來源未說明 OTA chamber、reverberation chamber、anechoic chamber、antenna performance 或 MIMO stress testing setup。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 支撐。
- 來源是 PR / demonstration statement，不是 datasheet、configuration guide、IEEE standard text 或 certification document。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 Wi‑Fi 8 option code、license、software version、hardware configuration、RF chain count、test case list 或 measurement uncertainty。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[Broadcom]] prototype device 的正式產品名稱、量產狀態、客戶、driver version、chipset SKU 或商用 availability。
- 來源未標示 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] draft version、final ratification date 或正式標準版本。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 支撐。
- 來源是 PR / demonstration positioning，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、test case list 或 certification document。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi 7 的 option code、software release、支援 RF chains 數量、MLO link combination、measurement uncertainty 或完整 test coverage。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMP180]] 480 MHz waveform 的正式 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 標準地位、量測規格或 production throughput。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術挑戰
來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| channel bandwidth | increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz |
| spatial streams | up to 16 spatial streams |
| modulation | 4096 QAM modulation |
| MLO | key feature；使 multiple RF chains 測試環境變重要 |

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 架構與用途
來源中的 WoMT 架構可整理為：

1. 產生或處理 native [[Wi-Fi 7]] / IEEE 802.11be signal。
2. 透過 [[AiP]] / antenna-in-package module 執行 integrated antenna 與 up-conversion。
3. 將信號搬移到 27 GHz mmWave band，來源以 n257 / n258 表示。
4. 用於 Integrated Radio CPEs 與 WoMT-AP。
5. 在 RD / manufacturing setup 中分成 WIFI IB band 與 WIFI mmWave path。
6. 透過 OTA / RF test 確認 EVM、[[EIRP]]、[[TRP]]、[[ACLR]]、[[EIS]]、occupied bandwidth 與 Rx / OOB spurious emissions。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 測試需求
依 [[R&S for JIO Project]] 與 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]，WoMT 測試至少包含：

- OTA precision measurement：使用 [[R&S ATS1800C]] CATR chamber。
- TX analysis：[[EIRP]]、[[TRP]]、[[ACLR]]、EVM under Wi-Fi 7 modulation。
- RX analysis：[[EIS]] sensitivity verification。
- Spurious：Rx / OOB spurious emissions monitoring。
- Occupied bandwidth。
- Native Wi-Fi / IF / IB band：[[R&S CMP180]]。
- mmWave signal generation and analysis：[[R&S CMP200]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]]。
- R&D fine tuning：[[R&S FSW67]] 與 signal sources。
- Production / manufacturing setup：[[R&S CMQ200]] 與 automation SW WMT 只作為來源列名，尚無詳細流程。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 矛盾與口徑差異
⚠️ [[R&S for JIO Project]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）說 [[R&S SMM100A]] frequency range up to 67 GHz，但既有頁面 [[R&S SMM100A]] 說 Version 31.00 specifications 的最高 frequency option 為 44 GHz；新來源 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）在 RD site setup 仍列 [[R&S SMM100A]] as SG，卻在 appendix 以 [[R&S SMA100B]] 列出 8 kHz to 67 GHz。判斷：WoMT 方案材料中的 signal generator 型號 / 規格可能混用，正式頻率範圍須以產品 specifications 為準。

R&S SMM100A › 定位與用途
依 [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]，[[R&S SMM100A]] 的主要能力包含：

- Frequency range：`100 kHz to 44 GHz`。
- High output power：up to `+18 dBm`。
- Internal RF modulation bandwidth：up to `2 GHz`。
- 支援 5G NR signal generation for FR1 and FR2。
- RF frequency 與 modulation bandwidth 用於 future WLAN requirements。
- Excellent SSB phase noise、EVM、ACPR/ACLR performance。
- Internal real-time signal generation。
- Arbitrary waveform generator。
- Custom digital modulation。
- Keycode extendable bandwidth and ARB memory。
- Timed licenses、waveform packs、floating licenses。
- Structured GUI、touchscreen、block diagram operation、graphical signal monitoring in real time。
- Context-sensitive help system 與 SCPI recording。
- `R&S®SMM-K544` frequency response correction。
- Envelope tracking。
- High rate pulse（HRP）ultrawideband（UWB）。

依 [[R&S for JIO Project]]，[[R&S SMM100A]] 在 [[R&S WoMT 測試方案]] 中被簡報列為 RX sensitivity and blocking tests 的 signal source；但該簡報的 67 GHz frequency range 主張不得覆蓋正式 specifications。

R&S SMM100A
[[R&S SMM100A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Vector Signal Generator；依 `R&S®SMM100A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`，透過 `R&S®SMM-B10xx` frequency options 覆蓋 `100 kHz to 6 GHz` 到 `100 kHz to 44 GHz`，並支援最高 `2 GHz` internal RF modulation bandwidth、5G NR FR1/FR2、ARB、real-time baseband、custom digital modulation、envelope tracking 與 HUMS（來源：[[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]）。

⚠️ [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]（June 2026）讀圖補充 p049 與 p051 頁尾說 `R&S®SMW100A Vector Signal Generator`，但既有頁面 [[R&S SMM100A]] 說本文件產品為 `R&S®SMM100A Vector Signal Generator`。判斷為來源頁尾疑似誤植；本頁仍以封面、p050、文件名稱、ordering information 與 source_path 的 `SMM100A` 為主，並在 Unresolved 保留此不一致。

⚠️ [[R&S for JIO Project]]（2026-09-17 converted；來源未標示正式日期）說 [[R&S SMM100A]] Frequency Range: Up to 67 GHz，但既有頁面 [[R&S SMM100A]] 說依 [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]（June 2026 / May 2026 未決）SMM100A 最高 frequency option 為 100 kHz to 44 GHz。判斷：[[R&S for JIO Project]] 是 Market / project deck，且同一簡報 slide 24 另列 [[R&S SMA100B]] 8 kHz to 67 GHz；因此 67 GHz 很可能是簡報混淆或 sales-slide 錯植。正式規格以 [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]] 為準，Jio WoMT use-case 中引用此簡報時需保留矛盾。

R&S SMM100A › 主要 RF frequency options（Version 31.00）
| Frequency option | Frequency range | Attenuator | Order No. |
|---|---:|---|---|
| `R&S®SMM-B1006` | `100 kHz to 6 GHz` | electronically controlled attenuator | `1440.9009.02` |
| `R&S®SMM-B1007` | `100 kHz to 7.5 GHz` | electronically controlled attenuator | `1440.9109.02` |
| `R&S®SMM-B1012` | `100 kHz to 12.75 GHz` | electronically controlled attenuator | `1440.9209.02` |
| `R&S®SMM-B1020` | `100 kHz to 20 GHz` | mechanically controlled step attenuator | `1440.9309.02` |
| `R&S®SMM-B1031` | `100 kHz to 31.8 GHz` | mechanically controlled step attenuator | `1440.9409.02` |
| `R&S®SMM-B1044` | `100 kHz to 44 GHz` | mechanically controlled step attenuator | `1440.9509.02` |
| `R&S®SMM-B1044N` | `100 kHz to 44 GHz` | mechanically controlled step attenuator；I/Q bandwidth and minimum pulse width limited from `20 GHz to 44 GHz` | `1440.9609.02` |

其他 frequency 規格：resolution of setting `0.001 Hz`；resolution of synthesis at `f = 1 GHz` `0.053 nHz (nom.)`；phase offset setting `0.1° steps`。Standard frequency setting time 條件含 GUI update stopped、I/Q optimization mode `fast`、after IEC/IEEE bus delimiter、HUMS off，依 option 約 `< 1.2 ms` 到 `< 1.7 ms`。Frequency sweep 為 digital sweep in discrete steps，dwell time `1 ms to 100 s`，resolution `0.1 ms`。

- [[R&S CMX500]] 配置包含 OBT lite、OBT、OBT plus、OBT FR1 specialist、OBT FR2 specialist，主要差異在 [[R&S CMX-B200A]] accelerator unit、[[R&S CMX-B500A]] IF unit、[[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF unit 的數量。
- [[NR FR1]] 與 [[LTE]] 測試使用 integrated RF units；[[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF unit 的 frequency range 為 **400 MHz to 8000 MHz**。
- [[NR FR2]] 測試可搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] remote radio head；remote radio head 在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。
- 適用的 radiated chamber test environments 包含 [[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 vector signal analysis 與 ARB generator，可做 FR2 transmitters / receivers RF parametric testing；5G NR receiver tests 可在 3GPP fading propagation conditions 下使用 internal baseband fading emulation。
- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後，warm-up operation 30 分鐘，符合指定 environmental conditions，遵守 recommended calibration interval，且已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 來源中的測試架構
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）描述的架構為：

- [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 提供 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] control software / integrated test environment 整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS），例如 [[Bluetest RTS65]]，提供 reverberation chamber OTA environment。
- 測試對象為 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points。
- 測試目標為 MIMO stress testing under realistic conditions。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[Bluetest]] expanded its earlier integrated testing capabilities for [[WLAN]] stations and access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] 現在支援 bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。
- 此能力與 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 與 [[Bluetest]] RTS 組成 single tester and reverberation test system 的 integrated path。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[EMITE]] over-the-air chambers 可 combined with the latest sophisticated testing features of [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 整合 enables support of [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] and [[5G RedCap]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 non-cellular technologies including latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- [[EMITE]] customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] as well as [[5G RedCap]] devices。

- 本頁目前由 [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]、[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 與 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 支撐。
- 本頁不推論 [[R&S CMX500]] 或 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 實際支援的 RF chains 數量、spatial streams 數量、MLO link combination、software option code 或 hardware configuration。
- 本頁不推論 [[Bluetest RTS65]]、其他 Bluetest RTS chambers 或 [[EMITE]] OTA chambers 的完整規格、measurement uncertainty、校準流程或 certification applicability。
- 本頁不把新聞稿中的 solution positioning 視為 conformance test coverage 或正式規格。
- [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 標示 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18，但未提供 release date、release notes、license requirement 或相容性矩陣。
- [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 使用 full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] 的語句，但未展開 compliance 的測試項目、標準版本、認證機構或是否等同正式 conformance / certification testing。

Wi-Fi 8 › 480 MHz waveform candidate 說法
[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 稱：

- [[R&S CMP180]] supports bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] will demonstrate its ability to verify a [[WLAN]] waveform with **480 MHz bandwidth** in loopback mode。
- 該 480 MHz waveform 被稱為 potential waveform candidate for the yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] standard。

此說法目前只能作為 MWC 2024 PR 的 candidate / discussion 記錄；不得推論 480 MHz 已成為 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 標準通道頻寬。

Wi-Fi 8 › 延續自 Wi-Fi 7 的 core PHY parameters
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]，[[Wi-Fi 8]] 保留下列 [[Wi-Fi 7]] core physical layer parameters：

| 項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| supported frequencies | up to 7.125 GHz |
| channel bandwidth | up to 320 MHz |
| modulation | 4096QAM |
| multi-link | [[MLO]] |

以上是 PR 中對 Wi-Fi 8 的簡述，不等同於完整 IEEE 802.11bn normative specification。

Wi-Fi 8
[[Wi-Fi 8]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 中對 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment 的市場 / 技術稱呼；該來源描述其重點從提高 throughput 轉向 ultra-high reliability（[[UHR]]）connectivity performance。較早的 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 則把 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 稱為 yet-to-be-defined，並提到 wider channel bandwidths are in discussion 與 480 MHz WLAN waveform potential candidate。

⚠️ [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]（MWC 2024；發布日期來源未標示）說 [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 尚未定義，且 even wider channel bandwidths are in discussion，並稱 480 MHz [[WLAN]] waveform 是 potential waveform candidate，但既有頁面 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 說依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] Wi‑Fi 8 保留 up to 320 MHz channel bandwidth。判斷：前者是較早期 discussion / candidate，後者是較晚 PR 的 implemented signaling-test description；先並列，不把 480 MHz 寫成 Wi‑Fi 8 正式規格。

Wi-Fi 8 › 與 R&S CMX500 / CMP180 的關係

[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 則在較早 MWC 2024 語境中，把 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 480 MHz [[WLAN]] waveform loopback demonstration 描述為 potential [[Wi-Fi 8]] candidate，並將 [[R&S CMP180]] 定位為 future-proof R&D / production tester。

CMX500 Desense Testing
[[CMX500 Desense Testing]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中描述的 WLAN + cellular one-box interference / desense use case：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 在真實連線下同時處理 WLAN、LTE 與 NR 測試，觀察互相干擾或 desense 影響。

R&S WoMT 測試方案 › RD site setup
依 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]] slide 5，RD site setup 包含：

- [[R&S FSW67]] signal analyzer。
- [[R&S ATS1800C]]。
- Tx measurement。
- [[R&S SMM100A]] signal generator。
- Rx measurement。

依 [[R&S for JIO Project]]，RD / OTA precision measurement 也以 [[R&S ATS1800C]] CATR chamber、[[R&S FSW67]] analyzer 與 signal sources 做 TX / RX verification。

R&S WoMT 測試方案 › 矛盾與口徑差異
⚠️ [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）說 [[R&S CMP180]] frequency up to 8.5 GHz、bandwidth 500 MHz，並寫 `CMP180-xxB` / `CMP180-xxH` both support max 8 GHz and 500 MHz BW，但既有頁面 [[R&S CMP180]] 說 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]（March 2026）將 500 MHz bandwidth 綁定 [[R&S CMP-K185]] 且 only available if [[R&S CMP-B805I]] or higher option is installed，RF generator maximum center frequency 8000 MHz、RF analyzer maximum center frequency 8250 MHz、analyzer overrange up to 8500 MHz。判斷：Jio 簡報為方案 / sales 口徑且 variant 記法粗略，正式配置與報價仍以 CMP180 specifications 為準。

⚠️ [[R&S for JIO Project]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）說 [[R&S SMM100A]] frequency range up to 67 GHz，但既有頁面 [[R&S SMM100A]] 說 Version 31.00 specifications 的最高 frequency option 為 44 GHz；新來源 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）在 RD site setup 仍列 [[R&S SMM100A]] as SG，卻在 appendix 以 [[R&S SMA100B]] 列出 8 kHz to 67 GHz。判斷：Jio 方案材料可能混用 SMM100A / SMA100B 或 signal generator appendix 頁，正式頻率範圍不可由 project deck 覆蓋 datasheet。

兩份來源共同支撐的測試項目包括：

- [[EVM]] under Wi-Fi 7 modulation。
- [[EIRP]]。
- [[TRP]]。
- [[ACLR]]。
- [[EIS]] sensitivity verification。
- Rx spurious emissions / [[OOB spurious emissions]]。
- [[Occupied bandwidth]]。
- OTA TX test。
- Beam characterization / verification（由 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]] slide 22 對 [[R&S CMP200]] 與 [[R&S ATS1800C]] integration 的描述支撐）。

[[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]] slide 7–15 多數只有章節標題，未提供可引用的測試值、limits、test IDs、uncertainty 或 pass / fail 結果。

- [[R&S CMQ200]] 與 [[R&S AMS32]] 在 full spec setup 中的實際角色需補正式產品資料或方案文件。

CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32 › 硬體架構摘要
- [[R&S CMX500]] hardware architecture 為 modular and scalable，front panel 與 rear panel 有 optional hardware units 的 slots。
- Standard hardware configurations 名稱包含 one box tester（OBT）：
  - **OBT**：2 RF units、2 IF units（optional）、3 AU。
  - **OBT lite**：1 RF unit、1 IF unit（optional）、1 AU。
  - **OBT plus**：3 RF units、2 IF units（optional）、2 AU。
  - **OBT FR1 specialist**：4 RF units、0 IF units、2 或 3 AU。
  - **OBT FR2 specialist**：1 RF unit、4 IF units、2 AU。
- 其他 hardware unit 組合也可行，總數最多 **7 units**（accelerator units + RF units + IF units）。
- Hardware units 組合限制：必須有 **1 到 4 accelerator units**、**0 到 4 IF units**、**0 到 4 RF units**。
- RF unit 支援 **400 MHz 到 8 GHz**，由 **4 TX** 與 **2 RX modules** 組成；每個 TX 支援最高 **200 MHz total carrier bandwidth**，分布於最高 **1 GHz instantaneous bandwidth（iBW）**；每個 RX 支援最高 **500 MHz bandwidth**。
- RF unit 有 **8 個 RF connectors**：4 個 RF Out、2 個 RF In、2 個 RF Com。
- RF unit 最大允許 carriers 數量為 **8（8CC）**。
- IF unit 加上 [[R&S CMXHEAD]] remote radio head 支援 NR FR2 frequencies；每個 IF unit 支援 **1 TRX**，最高 **800 MHz total carrier bandwidth**，分布於最高 **1 GHz iBW**。
- 不使用 remote radio head 時，IF frequencies 最高 **20 GHz**；搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]] 時 RF frequencies 最高 **43.5 GHz**；搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 時 RF frequencies 最高 **50.2 GHz**。
- 每個 accelerator unit 可 fading 的最大 cells 數包含：1 NR cell 8x8 MIMO、1 NR cell 16x4 MIMO 50 MHz bandwidth、2 NR cells 4x4 MIMO、4 NR cells 2x2 MIMO、2 LTE cells 8x4 MIMO、4 LTE cells 2x2 或 4x4 MIMO。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 提供 deployment calculation service（DCS），用於選擇符合 DUT band combinations、bandwidths 與 MIMO layers 需求的 [[R&S CMX500]] configuration。

CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32 › NR FR1 measurements
- R&S CMX-KM600 是 frequency range 1 對 NR uplink signals 執行任何 TX tests 的必要選項。
- R&S CMX-KM602 用於 UL carrier aggregation measurements；R&S CMX-KM604 用於 two TX antennas measurements。
- NR FR1 uplink measurements 包含 multi-evaluation、PRACH、SRS、TPC measurement。
- Multi-evaluation 支援 NR channel bandwidth **3 MHz 到 100 MHz**，可分析 FDD / TDD signals、NR standalone signals 與 intraband contiguous EN-DC signals。
- 所有 uplink measurements 適用的 RF frequency bands 包含 n1 to n3、n5、n7、n8、n12 to n14、n18、n20、n24 to n26、n28、n30、n31、n34、n38 to n41、n46 to n48、n50、n51、n53、n65、n66、n68、n70、n71、n72、n74、n77 to n101、n104 to n106、n109、n110、n250 to n256；n247、n248 可 via IF unit。
- NR FR1 sidelink measurement 的 RF frequency：n14、n38、n47、n79；list mode 不支援 sidelink measurements。

### Short answer
Wi‑Fi 7/8 increases the required Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer capability mainly in bandwidth, modulation quality/EVM, multi‑RF‑chain/MIMO/MLO handling, Wi‑Fi 8 feature analysis, and—in Wi‑Fi over mmWave cases—mmWave frequency and OTA/spurious coverage.[11][12][55][58][14]
### Measurement capability impact
| Technology change | Effect on SG / SA measurement capability |
|---|---|
| Wi‑Fi 7 uses 320 MHz channel bandwidth, 4096 QAM, up to 16 spatial streams, and MLO.[11] | The test setup must support wide WLAN bandwidth, high‑order modulation/EVM verification, and multi‑antenna / multi‑RF‑chain operation rather than only single‑link RF checks.[11][12] |
| Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing needs RF TX/RX measurements in signaling mode under real‑world conditions, and MLO makes multiple RF chains important.[12] | Measurement capability must include signaling‑mode TX/RX analysis and a test environment with multiple RF chains for MLO behavior.[12] |
| Wi‑Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing measures antenna, RF transmitter/receiver, and multi‑antenna performance under realistic multipath RF conditions.[3] | Analyzer/generator capability may need to operate inside OTA chamber workflows, not only conducted RF setups.[3][52] |
| Wi‑Fi 8 retains Wi‑Fi 7 core PHY parameters: frequencies up to 7.125 GHz, channel bandwidth up to 320 MHz, 4096QAM, and MLO.[55] | Native Wi‑Fi 8 SG/SA coverage still needs sub‑7.125 GHz WLAN frequency coverage, 320 MHz bandwidth, 4096QAM quality, and MLO-related measurement capability.[55] |
| Wi‑Fi 8 shifts emphasis toward ultra‑high reliability and adds dRU and UEQM test focus.[56][58] | Analyzer capability must support dRU measurements for uplink transmit power boost / reliability checks and UEQM analysis for per‑MIMO‑link modulation adaptation against specified MCS combinations.[58][60] |
| A 480 MHz WLAN waveform was demonstrated only as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn candidate, while CMP180 supports bandwidths up to 500 MHz.[54] | 480 MHz should be treated as an R&D / candidate waveform bandwidth requirement, not as a formal Wi‑Fi 8 standard requirement.[54][5] |
### Instrument capability references from the passages
| Instrument / role | Confirmed capability relevant to the requirement |
|---|---|
| R&S SMM100A Vector Signal Generator | Frequency range is 100 kHz to 44 GHz, internal RF modulation bandwidth is up to 2 GHz, and the source states RF frequency and modulation bandwidth are used for future WLAN requirements.[16][17] |
| R&S SMM100A Vector Signal Generator | The SMM100A specifications include IEEE 802.11be EVM signal performance examples.[40] |
| R&S FSW67 Signal and Spectrum Analyzer | R&S FSW67 is a 2 Hz to 67 GHz signal and spectrum analyzer.[19][76] |
| R&S FSW67 Signal and Spectrum Analyzer | Available analysis bandwidth options include 320 MHz, 512 MHz, 1.2 GHz, 2 GHz, 4.4 GHz, 6.4 GHz, and 8.312 GHz under the stated option conditions.[74][75] |
| R&S FSW67 in WoMT RD setup | The WoMT RD site setup lists R&S FSW67 as signal analyzer and R&S SMM100A as signal generator for Tx/Rx measurement.[90] |
### Limits
The passages do not support treating 480 MHz as an official Wi‑Fi 8 channel bandwidth; they only state it was a potential waveform candidate for a yet‑to‑be‑defined IEEE 802.11bn standard.[54][5]  
The passages do not support deriving CMX500 Wi‑Fi 8 option codes, RF chain count, test case list, or measurement uncertainty from the Wi‑Fi 8 PR material.[9]  
The passages state a conflict around SMM100A frequency range in WoMT project material, so the official SMM100A maximum should be kept as 44 GHz rather than using the project deck’s 67 GHz claim.[17][71]

⚠️ [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]（June 2026）讀圖補充 p049 與 p051 頁尾說 `R&S®SMW100A Vector Signal Generator`，但既有頁面 [[R&S SMM100A]] 說本文件產品為 `R&S®SMM100A Vector Signal Generator`。判斷為來源頁尾疑似誤植；本頁仍以封面、p050、文件名稱、ordering information 與 source_path 的 `SMM100A` 為主，並在 Unresolved 保留此不一致。

⚠️ [[R&S for JIO Project]]（2026-09-17 converted；來源未標示正式日期）說 [[R&S SMM100A]] Frequency Range: Up to 67 GHz，但既有頁面 [[R&S SMM100A]] 說依 [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]（June 2026 / May 2026 未決）SMM100A 最高 frequency option 為 100 kHz to 44 GHz。判斷：[[R&S for JIO Project]] 是 Market / project deck，且同一簡報 slide 24 另列 [[R&S SMA100B]] 8 kHz to 67 GHz；因此 67 GHz 很可能是簡報混淆或 sales-slide 錯植。正式規格以 [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]] 為準，Jio WoMT use-case 中引用此簡報時需保留矛盾。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 來源中的測試架構
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）描述的架構為：

- [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 提供 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] control software / integrated test environment 整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS），例如 [[Bluetest RTS65]]，提供 reverberation chamber OTA environment。
- 測試對象為 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points。
- 測試目標為 MIMO stress testing under realistic conditions。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[Bluetest]] expanded its earlier integrated testing capabilities for [[WLAN]] stations and access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] 現在支援 bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。
- 此能力與 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 與 [[Bluetest]] RTS 組成 single tester and reverberation test system 的 integrated path。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 non-cellular technologies including latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- [[EMITE]] customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] as well as [[5G RedCap]] devices。

Wi-Fi 8 › 480 MHz waveform candidate 說法
[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 稱：

- [[R&S CMP180]] will demonstrate its ability to verify a [[WLAN]] waveform with **480 MHz bandwidth** in loopback mode。
- 該 480 MHz waveform 被稱為 potential waveform candidate for the yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] standard。

此說法目前只能作為 MWC 2024 PR 的 candidate / discussion 記錄；不得推論 480 MHz 已成為 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 標準通道頻寬。

Wi-Fi 8 › 延續自 Wi-Fi 7 的 core PHY parameters
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]，[[Wi-Fi 8]] 保留下列 [[Wi-Fi 7]] core physical layer parameters：

| supported frequencies | up to 7.125 GHz |
| channel bandwidth | up to 320 MHz |
| modulation | 4096QAM |
| multi-link | [[MLO]] |

以上是 PR 中對 Wi-Fi 8 的簡述，不等同於完整 IEEE 802.11bn normative specification。

Wi-Fi 8
[[Wi-Fi 8]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 中對 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment 的市場 / 技術稱呼；該來源描述其重點從提高 throughput 轉向 ultra-high reliability（[[UHR]]）connectivity performance。較早的 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 則把 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 稱為 yet-to-be-defined，並提到 wider channel bandwidths are in discussion 與 480 MHz WLAN waveform potential candidate。

⚠️ [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]（MWC 2024；發布日期來源未標示）說 [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 尚未定義，且 even wider channel bandwidths are in discussion，並稱 480 MHz [[WLAN]] waveform 是 potential waveform candidate，但既有頁面 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 說依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] Wi‑Fi 8 保留 up to 320 MHz channel bandwidth。判斷：前者是較早期 discussion / candidate，後者是較晚 PR 的 implemented signaling-test description；先並列，不把 480 MHz 寫成 Wi‑Fi 8 正式規格。

Wi-Fi 8 › 新增 / 強調的 PHY 與 MAC layer technologies
[[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 舉例列出：

- [[distributed resource units]]（dRU）：用於 overcome power spectral density（PSD）limits；dRU measurements 可驗證 uplink transmit power boost 與 connection reliability improvement。
- [[unequal modulation]]（UEQM）：在 difficult reception scenarios 中允許 each [[MIMO]] link 使用 different modulation scheme；UEQM analysis 可評估 device 是否依 specified MCS combinations 正確 adapt modulation。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests › Wi-Fi 8 測試重點
來源描述 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] / [[Wi-Fi 8]] 的重點從 sheer speed 轉向 [[UHR]] performance。相關測試重點包括：

| 測試 / feature | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| [[distributed resource units]] / dRU measurements | 用於驗證 device boosting uplink transmit power 與 improving connection reliability 的 effectiveness；來源提到 dRU 可 overcome PSD limits。 |
| [[unequal modulation]] / UEQM analysis | 在 difficult reception scenarios 中允許 each MIMO link 使用不同 modulation scheme；測試可評估 device 是否以 specified MCS combinations 正確 adapt modulation。 |
| comprehensive signaling mode tests | 來源稱可 cover a broad range of Wi‑Fi 8 features 並執行 in-depth analysis of performance characteristics。 |
